description: Disposition tiers for the case risk score. The score itself is the sum of finding severity_weights (pipeline/scoring.py, a pure function); a case lands in the highest tier whose min_score it reaches. Rules-as-data: edit tiers here (and later via the policy sandbox, PLAN item 14), never in code.

tiers.label: Escalate
tiers.guidance: Serious or compounding breaches — supervisory action required.

tiers.label: Review
tiers.guidance: Material signal — case officer attention before any approval.
